title: DomainTrail configuration (domaintrail.jsonc / domaintrail.json)
description: Paths are relative to this file. CLI options (--out, --port, --host) take precedence.

sources.description: Globs of .dt files, inside the directory of this file. Patterns starting with '!' exclude. node_modules, .git and .domaintrail are never scanned.

ts.description: TypeScript types and command contracts (dmtr generate ts).

out.description: Output directory, inside the directory of this file. Files previously generated by domaintrail are replaced; other files are never deleted or overwritten.
